strings.zh: 前方的铃铛塔{NEWLINE}是为了给在天空中飞行的{CLEAR}传说中的精灵,{CLEAR}也就是凤王用作休息的地方{CLEAR}而修建的塔。{SCROLL}欲前往此塔之人{NEWLINE}必须对凤王心怀敬畏。{CLEAR}施主如果能回答对我的问题{CLEAR}展现对凤王的敬畏之心,{CLEAR}方可从此处通过。{SCROLL}现在要回答问题吗？
strings.en: The Bell Tower ahead was built as a{NEWLINE}resting place for the legendary Pokémon{CLEAR}that flies across the sky: Ho-Oh.{SCROLL}Those who wish to go to this tower must{NEWLINE}hold Ho-Oh in reverence.{SCROLL}If you can answer my questions{NEWLINE}correctly and show your reverence{CLEAR}for Ho-Oh, traveler, you may pass{CLEAR}through here.{SCROLL}Will you answer the questions now?

strings.zh: 第一道问题。{SCROLL}传说中烧焦塔曾经烧死过三只精灵,{NEWLINE}凤王后来对这三只精灵做了什么？{SCROLL}
strings.en: First question.{SCROLL}Legend says three Pokémon once{NEWLINE}burned to death in the Burned Tower.{CLEAR}What did Ho-Oh later do to those{CLEAR}three Pokémon?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: RV040: meaning: 对…做了什么 is neutral 'do to', 'do for' hinted the answer

strings.zh: 您已经展现了{NEWLINE}自己对凤王的了解和尊重。{CLEAR}请过去吧。
strings.en: You have shown your knowledge of{NEWLINE}Ho-Oh and your respect for it.{CLEAR}Please, go ahead.

strings.zh: 在见识到凤王那不可思议的力量后,{NEWLINE}人群中萌生出了{CLEAR}排斥、畏惧、占有等各种情绪,{CLEAR}于是有一部分人开始攻击凤王。{CLEAR}雷公、炎帝、水君为了保护凤王{CLEAR}对民众展开反击。{CLEAR}但凤王并不想伤害这里的人们,{CLEAR}为了平息事态,{CLEAR}凤王将三圣兽封印到镜子中,{CLEAR}然后自己腾空远去,{CLEAR}从那以后再也没有回来过。{SCROLL}还要继续听吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Witnessing Ho-Oh’s mysterious{NEWLINE}power stirred all sorts of feelings{CLEAR}in the people: rejection, fear,{CLEAR}the desire to possess it. And so some of{CLEAR}them began to attack Ho-Oh.{SCROLL}Raikou, Entei and Suicune fought back{NEWLINE}against the people to protect Ho-Oh.{SCROLL}But Ho-Oh did not wish to harm the{NEWLINE}people here. To calm things down,{CLEAR}Ho-Oh sealed the three legendary{CLEAR}beasts inside a mirror, then soared off{CLEAR}into the sky and never returned.{SCROLL}Would you like to keep listening?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 看到凤王离开的人们{NEWLINE}被凤王的仁爱宽容所感动,{CLEAR}便将凤王曾经栖息的铃铛塔视为圣地,{CLEAR}称曾经保护凤王的三只精灵为三圣兽。{SCROLL}或许是出于对凤王的尊重和思念,{NEWLINE}后来又有了这样的传说：{CLEAR}如果有一天灾难降临,{CLEAR}人们需要保护的时候,{CLEAR}凤王和三圣兽就会重现于世{CLEAR}与人们一起并肩战胜灾难。
strings.en: The people who watched Ho-Oh{NEWLINE}leave were moved by its compassion{CLEAR}and forgiveness.{SCROLL}They came to regard the Bell Tower,{NEWLINE}where Ho-Oh had dwelt, as sacred{CLEAR}ground, and named the three Pokémon{CLEAR}who had protected Ho-Oh the three{CLEAR}legendary beasts.{SCROLL}Perhaps out of respect and longing for{NEWLINE}Ho-Oh, a new legend arose:{SCROLL}If disaster ever strikes and the{NEWLINE}people need protecting, Ho-Oh and the{CLEAR}three legendary beasts will return to{CLEAR}the world and stand with the people{CLEAR}to overcome it.

strings.zh: 在我们城都地区有两个传说。{SCROLL}其中一个是漩涡岛的传说,{NEWLINE}然后另一个是{CLEAR}铃铛塔的传说……{SCROLL}我们在缘朱市{NEWLINE}一直在传承着{CLEAR}这个铃铛塔的传说。{SCROLL}你想听听关于铃铛塔的传说吗？
strings.en: There are two legends in our{NEWLINE}Johto region.{SCROLL}One is the legend of the Whirl Islands.{NEWLINE}The other is the legend of the{CLEAR}Bell Tower...{SCROLL}Here in Ecruteak City, we have handed{NEWLINE}down the legend of the Bell Tower{CLEAR}for generations.{SCROLL}Would you like to hear the legend of the{NEWLINE}Bell Tower?
strings.notes: US 0616/7 | rewritten from zh (was us) | US line rewritten: the zh ends with the question ‘Would you like to hear the legend?’ that the US text lacks

strings.zh: 七百年前,缘朱市修建了两座塔,{NEWLINE}分立东西两侧。{CLEAR}东侧的塔象征精灵苏醒,{CLEAR}而西侧的塔象征精灵沉睡。{CLEAR}相传凤王当时就居住在{CLEAR}东侧的铃铛塔塔顶。{SCROLL}还要继续听吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Seven hundred years ago, two towers{NEWLINE}were built in Ecruteak City, one on the{CLEAR}east side and one on the west.{SCROLL}The eastern tower symbolized{NEWLINE}the awakening of Pokémon,{CLEAR}and the western tower their slumber.{CLEAR}Legend says Ho-Oh lived at the very top{CLEAR}of the eastern one, the Bell Tower.{SCROLL}Would you like to keep listening?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 然而在150年前,{NEWLINE}一道闪电击中了西侧的塔,{CLEAR}整座塔瞬间变成火海,{CLEAR}大火燃烧了三天三夜,{CLEAR}最后一场大雨扑灭了火焰,{CLEAR}然而此时西侧的塔已经所剩无几。{CLEAR}有三只不知名的口袋妖怪{CLEAR}在那场大火中被烧死。{CLEAR}但紧接着凤王从天而降{CLEAR}并用神奇的力量使他们复活了。{SCROLL}这三只被复活的精灵{NEWLINE}就是传说中的雷公、炎帝、水君。{CLEAR}它们因为感激凤王的再造之恩,{CLEAR}便在西侧的烧焦塔住了下来,{CLEAR}成为了守护凤王的卫士。{SCROLL}还要继续听吗？
strings.en: But 150 years ago, lightning struck the{NEWLINE}western tower, and in an instant the{CLEAR}whole tower became a sea of flames.{SCROLL}The fire burned for three days{NEWLINE}and three nights until a great{CLEAR}rainstorm finally put it out. By then,{CLEAR}little of the western tower remained.{SCROLL}Three nameless Pokémon burned to death{NEWLINE}in that fire. But then Ho-Oh descended{CLEAR}from the sky and brought them back to{CLEAR}life with its miraculous power.{SCROLL}These three revived Pokémon are the{NEWLINE}legendary Raikou, Entei and Suicune.{SCROLL}Grateful to Ho-Oh for giving them new{NEWLINE}life, they settled in the Burned Tower{CLEAR}on the west side and became guardians{CLEAR}protecting Ho-Oh.{SCROLL}Would you like to keep listening?

strings.zh: 相传凤王离开前,{NEWLINE}给予了缘朱市的人们{CLEAR}召唤它回归的道具和方法。{CLEAR}据说供奉在铃铛塔上的透明铃铛,{CLEAR}就是当年传下来的{CLEAR}召唤凤王回归的道具。{SCROLL}但具体召唤凤王的方法是什么,{NEWLINE}又是谁在传承这个方法,{CLEAR}至今已经无从考证了。
strings.en: Legend says that before Ho-Oh left,{NEWLINE}it gave the people of Ecruteak City an{CLEAR}item and a method to call it back.{SCROLL}They say the Clear Bell enshrined in the{NEWLINE}Bell Tower is the very item handed down{CLEAR}to summon Ho-Oh’s return.{SCROLL}But what the method of summoning Ho-Oh{NEWLINE}actually is, and who carries it on,{CLEAR}can no longer be traced.

strings.zh: 回答错误。{SCROLL}看来你对传说故事了解的还不够啊,{NEWLINE}请多了解一些凤王的事再来吧。
strings.en: Wrong answer.{SCROLL}It seems you don’t know the legends{NEWLINE}well enough. Please learn more about{CLEAR}Ho-Oh and come back.

strings.zh: 第二道问题。{SCROLL}凤王复活的三只精灵{NEWLINE}被后人称为三圣兽。{CLEAR}它们是哪三只精灵？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Second question.{SCROLL}The three Pokémon revived by Ho-Oh{NEWLINE}came to be called the three legendary{CLEAR}beasts. Which three Pokémon are they?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 第三道问题。{SCROLL}看到被复活的精灵后,{NEWLINE}有人心生贪婪、有人心生恐惧,{CLEAR}凤王为了避免被复活的三只精灵{CLEAR}与人们发生冲突,{CLEAR}对三只精灵做了什么？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Third question.{SCROLL}Seeing the revived Pokémon, some people{NEWLINE}grew greedy and others grew afraid.{CLEAR}To keep the three revived Pokémon{CLEAR}from clashing with the people,{CLEAR}what did Ho-Oh do to them?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 第四道问题。{SCROLL}凤王封印了三圣兽之后,{NEWLINE}自己又做出了何种选择？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Fourth question.{SCROLL}After sealing away the three legendary{NEWLINE}beasts, what did Ho-Oh choose to{CLEAR}do itself?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 第五道问题。{SCROLL}根据传说,凤王和三圣兽{NEWLINE}何时会再次重现于世？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Fifth question.{SCROLL}According to legend, when will Ho-Oh{NEWLINE}and the three legendary beasts return{CLEAR}to the world?{SCROLL}

strings.notes: RV040: meaning: 人们需要保护时 = when people need protecting

strings.zh: 第六道问题。{SCROLL}从关于凤王的传说中,{NEWLINE}我们可以感受到{CLEAR}凤王是一只怎样的精灵？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Sixth question.{SCROLL}From the legends about Ho-Oh, what kind{NEWLINE}of Pokémon do we sense that Ho-Oh is?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 恭喜冠军大人回答对了全部问题,{NEWLINE}展现了自己对凤王的了解和尊重。{CLEAR}请过去吧。
strings.en: Congratulations, Champion.{NEWLINE}You answered every question correctly{CLEAR}and showed your knowledge of Ho-Oh and{CLEAR}your respect for it. Please, go ahead.

strings.zh: 缘朱市道馆馆主小松大人{NEWLINE}目前正在铃铛塔处理特别事务。{CLEAR}所以今天禁止游客参观铃铛塔,{CLEAR}施主请回吧。
strings.en: Morty, the Gym Leader of Ecruteak City,{NEWLINE}is attending to special business at the{CLEAR}Bell Tower right now.{SCROLL}So visitors are not allowed{NEWLINE}in the Bell Tower today.{CLEAR}Please turn back, traveler.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}现在有事要找小松馆主。{CLEAR}请你让我过去。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m the League Champion,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}, and I need to see Morty.{CLEAR}Please let me through.

strings.zh: 啊……！仔细一看您确实是冠军大人！{SCROLL}冠军大人如果有事找小松馆主{NEWLINE}我们理应放行。{CLEAR}只是按照缘朱市的习俗,{CLEAR}凡是前往铃铛塔之人{CLEAR}必须对凤王怀有尊重之心。{SCROLL}所以冠军大人需要回答我几个问题,{NEWLINE}展现自己对凤王的尊重之心,{CLEAR}我即可让路放行。{SCROLL}请问您现在要回答问题吗？
strings.en: Ah...! Now that I look closely,{NEWLINE}you really are the Champion!{SCROLL}If the Champion has business with{NEWLINE}Morty, we ought to let you through.{CLEAR}But by Ecruteak City’s custom,{CLEAR}all who go to the Bell Tower must hold{CLEAR}respect for Ho-Oh in their hearts.{SCROLL}So, Champion, please answer a few of{NEWLINE}my questions to show your respect for{CLEAR}Ho-Oh, and I will let you pass.{SCROLL}Would you like to answer the{NEWLINE}questions now?

strings.zh: 我是联盟冠军,有事要找小松馆主
strings.en: I’m the Champion. I need Morty.

strings.zh: 每次听到这里的师傅们{NEWLINE}说起凤王的故事,{CLEAR}我就感觉心潮澎湃。
strings.en: Every time I hear the sages here tell{NEWLINE}the story of Ho-Oh, my heart swells.

strings.zh: 好不容易来到缘朱市,{NEWLINE}却被告知今天铃铛塔不开放参观,{CLEAR}真是太让人失望了。
strings.en: I finally made it to Ecruteak City,{NEWLINE}only to be told the Bell Tower is closed{CLEAR}to visitors today. What a letdown.

strings.zh: 来铃铛塔祭拜祈祷,{NEWLINE}这是我们桔梗市居民的习俗。
strings.en: Coming to the Bell Tower to worship{NEWLINE}and pray is a custom for us folks from{CLEAR}Violet City.

strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛,冠军大人您是{NEWLINE}击败邪恶火箭队的英雄,{CLEAR}我从您身上感受到了正义的波导。{CLEAR}正好我这里有一个波导弹的技能,{CLEAR}非常适合您这种正义的训练家的精灵。{CLEAR}如果您有精灵想学习波导弹的话,{CLEAR}随时欢迎来找我。{SCROLL}怎么样,要让精灵学习波导弹吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Amitabha. Champion, you are the hero{NEWLINE}who defeated the wicked Team Rocket.{CLEAR}I sense a righteous aura in you.{SCROLL}As it happens, I can teach the move{NEWLINE}Aura Sphere, which is perfect for the{CLEAR}Pokémon of a righteous Trainer like you.{CLEAR}If any of your Pokémon wish to learn it,{CLEAR}come to me anytime.{SCROLL}Well? Shall your Pokémon learn{NEWLINE}Aura Sphere?{SCROLL}
